newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA VANKE H1 NET 65.68 MLN YUAN.
newsitem.headline: CHINA VANKE H1 NET 65.68 MLN YUAN.

text.p: Conglomerate China Vanke Co Ltd notched up net profits of 65.68 million yuan on sales of 822.81 million yuan for the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
The company's per-share net reached 0.18 yuan in the first half, with net assets per share at 3.84 yuan, the exchange said in a notice issued after the market closed.
It did not give comparative figures or say whether the figures were based on international or Chinese accounting standards.
For the first half of 1996, Vanke posted net profits of 59.75 million yuan under international standards.
Based on Chinese standards, the company booked net profits of 53.60 million yuan for the first six months of 1996.
Trading in Vanke's A and B shares would be suspended on Friday morning for the results announcement and would resume in the afternoon, it said.
